request.evidence: Follow resolved calls backwards from the callee to its callers, recursively. Calls include callback references (call_kind 'callback'), where a function is passed to another call such as asyncio.to_thread(f, x). Overridden methods called through a base class (self._run_once() in a base class) are not followed to the subclass.
request.question:
What would be affected if resolve_semantic_fks changed? List every resolved caller symbol, including standalone functions, methods and class-scope callers, reached directly or indirectly, with the shortest call depth, outside the tests.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. After executing SQL, describe the returned rows and query assumptions. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.

data.note: Generated SQL and reference SQL are retained separately. This endpoint executes neither.
data.reference_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY i.symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id;
data.sql: WITH RECURSIVE callers AS (SELECT c.callee_symbol_id AS current_id, c.caller_symbol_id AS caller_id, 1 AS depth, list_value(c.callee_symbol_id, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM code.calls AS c INNER JOIN code.symbols AS t ON c.callee_symbol_id = t.symbol_id WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') OR c.call_kind = 'callback') UNION ALL SELECT c.callee_symbol_id AS current_id, c.caller_symbol_id AS caller_id, w.depth + 1 AS depth, list_append(w.path, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM callers AS w INNER JOIN code.calls AS c ON c.callee_symbol_id = w.caller_id WHERE c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') OR c.call_kind = 'callback') AND NOT list_contains(w.path, c.caller_symbol_id)) SELECT w.caller_id AS symbol_id, MIN(w.depth) AS depth FROM callers AS w INNER JOIN code.symbols AS cs ON cs.symbol_id = w.caller_id INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE GROUP BY w.caller_id ORDER BY depth, symbol_id

data.answer: This walks the call graph backwards from every symbol named resolve_semantic_fks, following resolved internal calls (including callback references passed as arguments) to their callers, then to those callers' callers, and so on. Each affected caller symbol is reported once with the smallest number of hops that reaches it, and callers located in test files are excluded using the file-level test flag. The output lists the full repository-relative symbol identifier and the shortest call depth, ordered from closest callers outward.
